versions.changelog: The API key is now optional to load this skill; with no key, a pointer leads to a temporary free key with no signup and a link the user opens to keep it.
Refreshes the endpoint table (Score movers, Street rating changes, this week's earnings), adds a call budget and rate-limit pacing for free keys, and scales the Score bar to the fetched values.
Adds a scoped handoff to the heatmap skill for the broader market picture around a watchlist; removes the npx execution path and declares permissions.
Names market-heatmap as the market-wide companion (one call, self-contained file) in the Extending it section.

Delivery: OpenClaw 2026.8.1 show_widget route (widget_code + title, pin:true with a stable name for in-place refresh that survives /new and /reset, large size, inline-limit note, and no netOrigins: the agent fetches with its own key and renders a snapshot, so the widget works under every permission mode). Canvas and file routes unchanged.

Size the Street moves panel from measured volume: filtering to real rating changes leaves only about 10 to 15 market-wide per day, so a twenty-row panel will look empty. Also drop rows whose grades did not move, which otherwise render as 'UPGRADE Buy to Buy'.
Generalized delivery guidance for HTML render surfaces: treat them as display, not interaction.
New Delivering-the-file section: where the file lives, chat-surface limitations, local-serve and render-panel routes.
Score range aligned with the reference, agent identity guidance
Dashboard honesty rules state prices as 15-minute delayed with priceAsOf, not live
First release. Builds a stock market dashboard as a single self-contained HTML file from live market data.
